title: Reuse is a data-movement strategy
purpose: Separate adjacent-address consumption from reuse before eviction.
contract: Spatial locality concerns nearby addresses; temporal locality concerns reuse.
Cache behavior is a hardware/workload property, not a shape guarantee.
No cache counters were collected for the historical chapter measurements.
